id: title:TueHaulund:harden the watch rank consumer and add the metrics its alerts need

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Prometheus metrics and database transaction timeouts to the Watch Rank consumer, improving observability and preventing database blocking.
review.reason: The change adds Prometheus metrics for batch duration and naming outcomes, and wraps semantic assignment and theme naming with transaction-local and named timeouts. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and observability for the Watch Rank consumer, without broader systemic architectural changes.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the assumption that these changes are not part of a larger systemic overhaul; no broader context is available. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation, not by unverified production outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic benefit and implementation completeness.
